name: Puck Breaks Emilia's Ice Seal in Elior Forest
description: The Great Spirit of Fire (in feline form) awakens Emilia from nearly a century of frozen stasis, contracting with her as her guardian spirit.

name: Extinction of the Royal Line & Dragon Tablet Prophecy
description: Every member of the Lugunica royal bloodline tragically succumbs to a sudden virulent illness. The Dragon Stone reveals the covenant decree: five candidates must contest the throne.

name: Natsuki Subaru is Summoned to Lugunica (Day 0)
description: Ordinary high schooler Natsuki Subaru is abruptly transported from a convenience store in Japan to Lugunica, quickly discovering his terrifying ability: Return by Death.

name: The Loot House Clash & Elsa Granhiert's Ambush
description: Subaru navigates multiple deadly loops to save Emilia from the Bowel Hunter Elsa Granhiert, aided at the final hour by the modern Sword Saint Reinhard.

name: Roswaal Manor Curse Loops & Wolgarm Subjugation
description: Subaru overcomes the cursed shaman bites of the Wolgarm puppy mabeasts, earns the deep trust of Rem and Ram, and secures his standing in the manor.

name: Royal Selection Declaration & The Fall of the White Whale
description: After the dramatic announcement of the five dragon priestess candidates, Subaru orchestrates a joint crusade with Crusch and Anastasia, successfully felling the legendary White Whale and avenging Theresia.

name: Liberation of Sanctuary & Annihilation of the Great Rabbit
description: Emilia passes the trials of the Tomb. Subaru contracts with Beatrice to vanquish the infinite swarm of the Great Rabbit into an alternate dimension, ending the 400-year barrier.

name: The Siege & Liberation of Water Gate City Priestella
description: Four Sin Archbishops seize control of Priestella's control towers. A unified camp coalition defeats Greed (Regulus) and repels Wrath and Lust, though Gluttony exacts heavy casualties.

name: Expedition to Pleiades Watchtower & Sand Dunes
description: Subaru and allies traverse the Augria Sand Dunes to conquer the Sage's Trials, encounter the scorpion guardian Shaula, and confront the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony.

name: The Great Disaster of the Sacred Vollachian Empire
description: Subaru and Rem are teleported to southern Vollachia, fighting alongside Emperor Vincent against imperial usurpers and the resurrected dead army of Sphinx.
